info.name: TRADElogs — Partner programme
info.description: Contract tests for apps/api/openapi/partners.openapi.yaml. Run with apps/api/postman/run.sh against a disposable database.

exec: pm.test("active with requested code", () => { pm.expect(d.status).to.eql('ACTIVE'); pm.expect(d.code).to.eql('ROHANFX'); pm.expect(d.approvedAt).to.be.a('string'); });
pm.test("invalid while pending", () => { pm.expect(pm.response.json().data).to.eql({ valid: false, partnerName: null }); });

item.name: Code check (case-insensitive) shows first name only

exec: pm.test("valid, first name", () => { pm.expect(pm.response.json().data).to.eql({ valid: true, partnerName: pm.collectionVariables.get('rohanName').split(' ')[0] }); });

pm.test("both listed", () => { const s = d.find(p => p.id === pm.collectionVariables.get('sanaPid')); pm.expect(s.status).to.eql('PENDING'); pm.expect(d.some(p => p.code === 'ROHANFX')).to.be.true; });

item.name: Same label again gets a unique slug

exec: pm.test("default + two channels", () => { pm.expect(d.channels).to.have.length(3); const def = d.channels.find(c => c.slug === null); pm.expect(def.label).to.eql('Direct link'); pm.collectionVariables.set('defaultChannelId', def.id); });
pm.test("redirects to signup with the code", () => { pm.expect(pm.response.headers.get('Location')).to.match(/\/signup\?ref=[A-Z0-9_-]+$/); });

pm.test("cookie is HttpOnly + Lax", () => { const raw = pm.response.headers.all().find(h => h.key.toLowerCase()==='set-cookie' && h.value.startsWith('tl_ref=')).value; pm.expect(raw).to.include('HttpOnly'); pm.expect(raw).to.match(/SameSite=Lax/i); });

item.name: Click ROHANFX via telegram (for pre-filled code)

exec: pm.test("redirects to signup with the code", () => { pm.expect(pm.response.headers.get('Location')).to.match(/\/signup\?ref=[A-Z0-9_-]+$/); });

pm.test("cookie is HttpOnly + Lax", () => { const raw = pm.response.headers.all().find(h => h.key.toLowerCase()==='set-cookie' && h.value.startsWith('tl_ref=')).value; pm.expect(raw).to.include('HttpOnly'); pm.expect(raw).to.match(/SameSite=Lax/i); });
pm.test("funnel", () => { pm.expect(d.funnel).to.include({ range: "ALL", from: null, clicks: 5, converted: 3, signups: 3, connected: 1, active: 0 }); });

pm.test("three clients, newest first", () => { pm.expect(d.totalClients).to.eql(3); pm.expect(d.recentClients.map(c => c.name)).to.eql([pm.collectionVariables.get('c7Name'), pm.collectionVariables.get('c3Name'), pm.collectionVariables.get('c1Name')]); });

pm.test("pre-filled code for the same partner keeps the link + channel", () => { const c7 = d.recentClients.find(c => c.name === pm.collectionVariables.get('c7Name')); pm.expect(c7).to.include({ via: 'link', channel: 'Telegram group' }); });

pm.test("c1 came through the telegram link and connected", () => { const c1 = d.recentClients.find(c => c.name === pm.collectionVariables.get('c1Name')); pm.expect(c1).to.include({ channel: 'Telegram group', via: 'link', status: 'CONNECTED', city: 'Mumbai', country: 'IN' }); pm.expect(c1.connectedAt).to.be.a('string'); });

pm.test("c3 fell back to the cookie (ROHAN-VIP) despite a bad typed code", () => { const c3 = d.recentClients.find(c => c.name === pm.collectionVariables.get('c3Name')); pm.expect(c3).to.include({ via: 'link', status: 'SIGNED_UP', channel: 'Direct link' }); });

pm.test("channels", () => { const tg = d.channels.find(c => c.slug === 'telegram-group'); pm.expect(tg).to.include({ clicks: 2, converted: 2, signups: 2, connected: 1 }); const def = d.channels.find(c => c.slug === null); pm.expect(def).to.include({ clicks: 3, signups: 1 }); });

pm.test("daily series ends today with running totals", () => { const last = d.daily[d.daily.length - 1]; pm.expect(last.date).to.eql(new Date().toISOString().slice(0,10)); pm.expect(last.clients).to.eql(3); pm.expect(d.daily.reduce((s,p) => s + p.clicks, 0)).to.eql(5); });
pm.test("activity feed has signup + connected events", () => { const kinds = d.activity.map(e => e.kind); pm.expect(kinds).to.include('signup'); pm.expect(kinds).to.include('connected'); });

pm.test("items + counts + meta", () => { const b = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(b.data.items).to.have.length(3); pm.expect(b.data.counts).to.eql({ all: 3, SIGNED_UP: 2, CONNECTED: 1, ACTIVE: 0, INACTIVE: 0 }); pm.expect(b.meta).to.eql({ page: 1, pageSize: 12, total: 3, totalPages: 1 }); });
pm.test("page 2 of 2", () => { const b = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(b.meta).to.include({ page: 2, totalPages: 2, total: 3 }); pm.expect(b.data.items).to.have.length(1); });

pm.test("per-code stats", () => { const m = Object.fromEntries(d.codes.map(c => [c.code, c])); pm.expect(m.ROHANFX).to.include({ clicks: 4, signups: 2 }); pm.expect(m['ROHAN-VIP']).to.include({ clicks: 1, signups: 1 }); });
pm.test("totals cover every code", () => { pm.expect(d.totals).to.eql({ clicks: 5, converted: 3, signups: 3 }); });

pm.test("recent clicks: 5, three converted", () => { pm.expect(d.recentClicks).to.have.length(5); pm.expect(d.recentClicks.filter(c => c.converted)).to.have.length(3); pm.expect(d.recentClicks[0].device).to.be.oneOf(["Desktop","Mobile","Tablet"]); });

item.name: Sana overview — typed code beat the cookie

exec: pm.test("code signup counts as a client but not a click conversion", () => { pm.expect(d.funnel.converted).to.eql(0); pm.expect(d.funnel.signups).to.eql(1); });

pm.test("one client via code", () => { pm.expect(d.totalClients).to.eql(1); pm.expect(d.recentClients[0]).to.include({ name: pm.collectionVariables.get('c2Name'), via: 'code', channel: 'Direct link' }); });
pm.test("one click recorded even though cookie was kept", () => { pm.expect(d.funnel.clicks).to.eql(1); });

item.name: Refresh stats (bridge offline → recorded as failure)

exec: pm.test("one connected client attempted", () => { pm.expect(d.processed + d.failed).to.eql(1); pm.expect(d.skipped).to.be.false; });
pm.test("no referrer", () => { const d = pm.response.json().data; pm.expect(d.user).to.not.eql(null); pm.expect(d.referredBy).to.eql(null); });

pm.test("row + codes + notes", () => { pm.expect(d.admin).to.include({ code: 'ROHANFX', clients: 3, connected: 1, clicks30d: 5, converted30d: 3 }); pm.expect(d.codes).to.have.length(2); pm.expect(d.notes.map(n => n.body)).to.include('Partner created by admin.'); });

item.name: Suspended partner link → home, no cookie

exec: pm.sendRequest({ url: pm.collectionVariables.get('baseUrl') + '/api/partner/links', header: { Cookie: pm.collectionVariables.get('rohanCookie') } }, (e, r) => pm.collectionVariables.set('rohanPrimaryCodeId', r.json().data.codes[0].id));

item.name: Partner can’t take a reserved name

exec: pm.test("suspend/reinstate/revoke/note present", () => { const b = pm.response.json().data.notes.map(n => n.body).join(' | '); ['Suspended. Reason: Spam reports','Reinstated.','Custom code ROHAN-VIP revoked.','Called him about the spam reports.','moved to'].forEach(s => pm.expect(b).to.include(s)); });
